name: ANOTHER VOYAGE
source:
I am her prisoner, in body and soul.
Tonight, like all nights, the captain's whispering voice and the scent of her hair drive me crazy...

in the unreal that is a battlefield, a man and a woman comfort each other.
At length, the man steps forward to a twisted future.
He abandons his ego. What is it he will find in the end?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ029698.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我是她的囚徒，无论是身体还是灵魂。
今晚，就像所有的夜晚一样，船长的低语声和她头发的香味让我发疯……

虚幻的战场上，一男一女互相安慰。
最终，这个男人走向了扭曲的未来。
他放弃了他的自我。他最终会发现什么？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ029698.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
